description:
This policy setting controls whether the LinkedIn Resume Assistant appears in Word.

If you enable or do not configure this policy, users will be able to use the LinkedIn Resume Assistant.

If you disable this policy setting, the LinkedIn Resume Assistant will not be available.

Important: This policy setting only applies to Office 365 clients that are installed by using Click-to-Run, including Office 365 ProPlus, Office 365 Business, Visio Pro for Office 365 and Project Pro for Office 365.  It doesn't apply to Office products that use Windows Installer (MSI).
